subject.title: Feature: --agent flag for TUI to select which agent handles the session

question: Should `openclaw tui --agent <id>` become a public startup selector, and what exact precedence should it have relative to `--session agent:<id>:...`, cwd workspace inference, remembered sessions, global session scope, and post-launch `/agent <id>`?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear from source, but adding the flag changes public CLI startup semantics for session ownership, workspace context, model/provider choice, and auth routing.

options.title: Add The Startup Selector
options.body: Make `--agent <id>` an additive public flag with explicit precedence, validation, docs, and focused upgrade-safe tests.

options.title: Keep Current Alternatives
options.body: Continue supporting canonical agent-scoped session keys, cwd workspace inference, and post-launch `/agent`, then defer or close this requested flag by maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Add The Startup Selector
recommendation.body: Make `--agent <id>` an additive public flag with explicit precedence, validation, docs, and focused upgrade-safe tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact TUI startup gap and has recent history on the relevant TUI startup and docs files.
